title: GameConfig
description: Gameplay physics and timing constants loaded from data/game.yaml at startup.

spawnX.description: Default spawn X coordinate for new players.

spawnY.description: Default spawn Y coordinate for new players.

spawnZ.description: Default spawn Z coordinate for new players.

ticksPerDay.description: Number of ticks in one in-game day.

timeBroadcastTicks.description: Ticks between game-time broadcasts to clients.

maxInteractionDistance.description: Maximum reach distance for block break/place (blocks).

debugWorld.description: Enable debug world mode: single GRASS block, fly spawn at (8,1,14), procedural generation disabled.
